title.label: Used to be the best, now nearly the worst

content.label:
The recent update has broken significant parts of the functionality. The developer seems to thing this is all about the redesign - but I like the new design! I just wished stuff worked. Slide over is completely broken, deleting episodes means the podcast remains in the now playing list, if you click on info for multiple episodes you still get the same info from the first episode. If you listen to the developers podcast, it’s all our fault because we don’t like change. I have no faith therefore this will get fixed because the developer is ignoring the real issue. 

Apparently developer says 1 star is for a horrible broken app that offers no value, well, this is a 1 star app.

I don’t know about the big update before it happened and found it a little tricky to get used to some of the changes but now I have it is great and I highly recommend everyone who enjoys podcasts to get this app.
I bemoaned the loss of a particular element during the most recent update. Now Marco has brought it back - thank you!!
The search facility doesn’t work so can’t find previous episodes quickly. Developer not interested either.

The old version worked fine for me, now it has been reworked, it is allegedly more robust, secure etc. ok.

But, using the info button on my iPad has no effect, and some podcasts just appear in “All” rather than “Current”.

I am sure it is a very worthy effort, and I have not paid a penny, but what is the point?

title.label: Latest update/redesign terrible - I have deleted this app

content.label:
Used to be brilliant. I used it for years. Recent update made everything harder and slower. No longer streams so you have to wait for whole episode to download before you can start listening. Features which used to be on front of listening screen (eg playback speed) now hidden behind further key presses.

I have deleted this app after many years’ use and have moved to a different podcast app

Been using for 5+ years.  Used to be the best, but a recent update removed the option to stream content and will not be re-added, as far as I understand. So now podcasts must be downloaded before listening.

Why remove streaming?  How is that an improvement?  Switching to a different app.  Shame.

title.label: Great update to an already great app

content.label: I’ve been an Overcast user for over 8 years and have always loved it.  It has great features which I never realised I needed until I tried them and found them indispensable.  The new UI update is terrific and brings the app nicely up to date.  This is my desert-island app: if I could keep only one third-party app on my phone, what would it be?  No-brainer: Overcast.
Was such a good app and has now been completely ruined. Podcasts just won’t play for hours on end

Baffling to try and make a playlist follow whatever you’re currently listening to on the fly. You need to plan ahead with a queue playlist and can’t put whatever you’re currently listening to as active even if you add it to queue mid play. This was fine before. Please bring ‘play next’ back!

I’ve been using this app for 10 years. 

I really like the new design. It’s clean and simple to use.

I miss streaming, as my broadband is slow, but I get why it had to go (blame the ad networks). 

All in all, give this a try, I bet you’d like it.

Overcast has always had the best functionality of any podcast player, but the user interface felt dated and unintuitive. The latest refresh has massively improved the UII and the general feel of the app. There are still a few rough edges on the new version, but given the active commitment from the developer I’m sure these will soon be smoothed out.
The new big update has completely ruined this app. So many things wrong, but the biggest one is you can no longer stream podcasts… What?! Useless.

My favourite things about this app were:

1. It had a great queue system. 
2. It didn’t automatically download my podcasts. 

Both have been made worse by the most recent update. 

1. The “add next in queue” and “add last in queue” buttons have been replaced with just an “add to queue” button. 

2. Not automatically downloading podcasts makes it take such a long time to download the podcasts. This was never an issue previously. 

I’d say it was just the one update but there have been 2 recent updates, both of which have made it harder to use. I don’t understand why you’d remove useful features that made the app great before.

After years loving Overcast, there was a complete overhaul in July this year. Since then, play/pause on headphones only works while actually listening to an episode. When an episode ends, pressing ‘play’ on the headphones no longer works. So I can no longer listen to podcasts when walking, cooking, cleaning, gardening, driving, in bed at night … well, any activity when I can’t or don’t want to have my phone out. I contacted Marco three times asking if he will fix this, but no reply. So it will be goodbye from me. Can anyone recommend a good Podcast app? I’ll live without all Overcasts good features just to have this one essential back.
Been using it for 10 years and it's still the best
I've happily used this for several years. This iteration is awful. Where is it improved? And why do it?

title.label: Syncing takes several minutes on start up

content.label: Used this app a lot but since the update to takes minutes to boot up due to syncing … almost finished walking the dog by this point.
Great podcast player which is still being actively on. Love the new update and its more simplistic design without loosing any features.
Marcos done a great job on the re-write. It’s snapper in every way. Love the new layout and new features. Stop whining about tiny design changes, just get used to it

title.label: The July 24 rewrite is a mess

content.label:
I’ve waited weeks for this to improve, but I’ve had it. The old app worked fine, this it’s a buggy mess. Podcasts still don’t end then continue to the next one. Sometimes played position is lost and it resets back to the beginning. AirPlay to HomePods is a disaster zone with dropped output between podcasts. 
I’ve paid happily for years for Overcast, this re-write is riddled with bugs, albeit fast found bugs. I won’t be renewing my subscription as I’ve lost confidence in it and will try other apps. 
This re-write was never ready for release. 
Still has the best podcast audio tools - but what good is that if the rest of the app is non functional?
Why remove the swipe option on the podcast cover art to access settings and description plus chapters??
Well done for the massive rewrite - it’s appreciated. Already noticing some excellent small changes and loving the new like and feel. Looking forward to the next 10years.

Congratulations to the new version. Needed a few days to adjust, but now it’s just great, again. 
 
One feature request would be to position the currently playing chapter in the vertical center of the screen when the list of chapters spans over more than one screen. That way one would not need to scroll manually down. 

Thank you for this great podcast app!!! Love it.

title.label: Best podcast app I’ve used so far

content.label: Good, functional app. Does everything it needs to and does it well.
Excellent app before the update. Huge improvement after the update but somethings have changed, life moves on. Incredible design details as well so should get an Apple design award! Straight-lines!!!

I’ve been an avid, paying user of Overcast since the very early days but the latest unnecessary redesign has removed the “Play Next” button for queueing up podcast episodes to listen to after the current one ends. I emailed the developer asking for it to be reinstated but he didn’t reply or acknowledge it in any way. I’ve now had to reluctantly switch to Pocket Casts.

The new app is a damn mess and you’re lying to yourself. The audio engine didn’t change? So why does it drop out every time I lock my device or navigate away from the app which never happened before? You fixed the issue with the playlists reordering themselves and I hope you fix this too but these are things that never should have happened when you announced this update with such bravado. I hope you remain ashamed of yourself for the rest of your life.

title.label: It's just the best podcast app

content.label: The developer cares, and you can tell. Thought is put into the app, and a huge attention to detail. Using it for free is a better experience than anything else but the yearly subscription is worth every penny.

It's still the best podcast app for iOS, but the recent revamp has made it a lot less intuitive than it used to be: I'm swiping and tapping all over the place trying to find things such as the sleep timer that used to be so easy to use

title.label: This one my top 3 essential apps on iOS/iPadOS

content.label: I love this app so much, and the latest refresh is awesome. I definitely find the app faster, visually a bit slicker. It will remain my go to Podcast app for the foreseeable future.

I’ve been using Overcast for years now. I have tried a few other podcast apps but always come back to it. Making podcast apps must be harder than I’d imagined because many of the others didn’t seem to be able to do the stuff I take for granted in Overcast. It downloads and plays podcasts reliably, syncs between all my devices and displays show notes in full. I’m looking forward to seeing what will be added now it has been rewritten with a new code base.
Great rewrite, app feels smoother and simpler to use. Looking forward to the upcoming features on the roadmap and the ability to implement new APIs with less friction.
Hands down the best podcast app. The design might need some getting used to but it works so well. Love the smart resume feature.

One of the best apps across the whole of iOS. Clearly produced by somebody who loves audio and podcasting. Took me a day or so to get used to the new design, but any hiccups well worth it. Works smoothly.
I wondered why I started having lots of problems with the app since the redesign and it turns out it’s because it can no longer stream podcasts. I can’t use a podcast app that can’t stream.

title.label: Oh dear, no more import and export

content.label: Latest update a mess. Many missing features and buggier than a bag of bees. I used to love this app. It was ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ but the dev didn’t test this new version, just showed it to his friends who all said it was amazing. It’ll be 5 stars again when the problems are sorted.

It’s not for me to say what was necessary or desirable from a design development perspective but it’s always going to bring criticism if a much-loved utility is replaced with something functionally inferior.

For me, the most annoying change is where you  have a playlist, eg Next Up, but have set up stop after each podcast ends.  Now, the app shuts down entirely and clicking play on headphones etc doesn’t do anything!  All along prior to this redesign, clicking play on headphone after a podcast had finished would simply play the next one.  As I listen at night, to help with sleep problems and pain, I have to now got to reach over, open the app again and select the next pod to play. It adds too much interference, disturbance and pain and it’s really upsetting me while I’m trying hardest to stay still and relaxed.

title.label: Marco Arment brought the world 20 years of darkness

content.label:
The Apple podcast app works perfectly fine and is better integrated into iOS. Also isn’t designed by an arrogant bag of hot air who thinks he’s a designer when he has the worst taste in the world (he listens to PHISH)

And if that isn’t enough - Marco is the co-creator of Tumblr, which unleashed upon the world 20 years of darkness. He has caused more destruction to culture than most and that should not be forgotten.

A relatively long time premium user and ATP listener. I wish that streaming was still an option but the redesign is fresh and fast. The currently missing functionality isn’t something I use regularly. This is still my favourite podcast app and my top recommendation.

I really don’t understand how people are complaining about Marco being “unresponsive“ when there’s social media posts, podcast discussion, frequent updates with release notes and an in-app update notice. Not every developer can individually respond to every individual demand personally!

title.label: Stop looking. This is your podcast app.

content.label: Everything that you actually need is here in this app. Nothing you don't need. As a podcast listener, you just want to curate your listening experience as you wish to have it, and everything else sink into the background. No other pod app does it like this one, and so completely successfully. Stop searching, this is the app you're looking for.
Has a fresh new look but the same great app. Really appreciate the time and effort Marco put into rewriting this app for a modern framework. 5 stars.
This has always been a great podcast app, I've been using it for years now. The recent big update has made it faster and more enjoayable to use, with some great new features. Love it!!!

No doubt the best podcast app has just had a major redesign and some people are clearly upset. But the developer/owner is hugely committed and deserves a little time to work out the wrinkles. I am 100% confident that the <5% that needs fixing will get fixed. Meanwhile, still a 5* app in my view.

The lastest major update is a broken buggy mess with a less friendly UI. 

The app frequently loses my place in an episode. The one thing the app needs to do, to play podcasts, and it can’t do it. 

Glad my premium expired, will not renew.
It can’t stream anymore I assume so podcast friends get more ads served but it can’t download because it’s so broken Just terrible you should be ashamed
Glad to see fixes coming
Best podcast app. Period. Tenth anniversary rewrite is slowly refining itself to be the best version of itself yet by far.

title.label: New UI is a treat that takes getting so used to

content.label:
The new UI is better but old habits are hard to break. 
After actually using it for a few weeks I like the changes and look forward to more updates.

title.label: Have been using for over 10 years!

content.label: Have used overcast since the day it launched and I have no plans to change. Love the recent refresh to the design, really modernised the look and feel - here’s to another 10 years!
